summary: Iteration 28 — Rewards ecosystem + AI Challenge Agent verification. BACKEND: 22/22 pytest passed (test_iteration28_rewards_agent.py). Regression invariants intact: /api/settings/crew-rates driver=28/helper=24 unchanged, /api/commissions/rates alive, /api/challenges returns 4 challenges with legacy badge/title/combo reward kinds, /api/badges returns 27+ badges, /api/leaderboard + /api/hall-of-fame both 200. Rewards config: GET /api/rewards/config owner 200 (20+ keys incl. pointsPerDollar=10, crewMonthlyBudget=300); sales+crew tokens both 403 on GET and PUT; PUT persists maxSingleReward change and restores. Recognition: POST /api/rewards/recognition 250pts to QA Crew One credits balance +250, reward status='approved', source='recognition', payroll_required=false (points-only). Cross-user wallet fetch by crew-role token → 403. Non-owner (sales+crew) approve/deny/fulfill/void → 403 (all 4 verbs). Challenge validation: reward_amount=9999 → 422 (over $100 maxSingleReward cap). Redemption catalog seeds 9 items. Redeem POST as owner → 403/422 (correctly requires user-account principal). AI agent: /challenge-agent/status owner 200 with config+ai_spend{crew,sales}; sales+crew 403; generate {team:'crew',count:2} returns drafts (source='ai' or 'fallback'); PATCH draft with reward_amount=5000 → 422 (guardrail); reject removes draft from list. FRONTEND (owner): /team-admin has admin-tab-rewards + admin-tab-agent testids; Rewards tab renders budget summary (Crew $0/$300, Sales $0/$400), queue tabs (Pending/Approved/Fulfilled/All), catalog manager with 9 rows (Amazon/gas/restaurant $25, Visa/Amazon/merch/lunch $50, $100 gift card), Give recognition dialog (recognition-dialog testid) opens on click, Reward settings + Payroll CSV buttons present. AI Agent tab renders agent-status-card ('On', drafts waiting: 6, spend crew $0/$200 sales $0/$250, last auto-run: ok), Generate/Crew only/Sales only buttons, 6 agent-draft-card rows with team+category+difficulty chips, Target/Reward/Verification/Eligibility/Why lines, and Approve&publish/Edit/Regenerate/Reject buttons (draft-publish-btn, draft-edit-btn testids present). agent-settings-save-btn present. Challenges page (/challenges) shows '0 Haul Points' chip and 4 challenge-reward-label instances with type/owner-verified/One Winner chips. Mobile 390px: challenges page renders without horizontal overflow, points chip visible, all 4 reward labels visible. Cleanup done via mongo: TEST_iter28 rewards+ledger deleted (recognition rewards were credited to QA Crew ephemeral users that get deleted post-pytest, so void-refund API returned 404 by design — direct mongo deletion used instead).
critical_code_review_comments: Rewards engine is properly gated: all state-changing endpoints (config PUT, approve/deny/fulfill/void, recognition, catalog CRUD, agent generate/patch/publish/reject/status) use require_owner; sales+crew tokens correctly get 403 on every one.
Recognition points-only rewards are auto-approved (status='approved', approved_by set) and points credited to users.haul_points + points_ledger — invariant confirmed by wallet read-back.
Challenge reward validation correctly enforces maxSingleReward cap on create (value = amount + points/pointsPerDollar) — 9999 rejected with 422 as spec'd.

AI agent guardrails correctly reject a $5000 amount patch on an existing draft (422). Deterministic template fallback path is exercised when Emergent LLM is unavailable (source='fallback' is acceptable).
Wallet cross-user privacy enforced: crew-role token requesting another user's wallet returns 403; matches 'reward history is private' contract.

Frontend testids required by the review are all present and wired to correct components (admin-tab-rewards, admin-tab-agent, give-recognition-btn, rewards-settings-btn, recognition-dialog, agent-status-card, agent-draft-card, draft-publish-btn, draft-edit-btn, agent-settings-save-btn, challenge-reward-label, challenge-eligibility-select, badge-unlock-hint, rewards-wallet).

One low-priority note: void_reward on a reward whose user_id no longer exists returns 404 'No such member.' from credit_points. This is only reachable when a user is hard-deleted after being credited — in normal ops users are deactivated, not deleted. Not a bug for this build; flagging for awareness.
Legacy invariants confirmed clean: crew rates (28/24), 27+ badges, 4 existing challenges with badge/title/combo reward kinds, leaderboard + hall-of-fame endpoints all 200.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required testids + flows render for owner desktop + mobile 390px)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Rewards + AI agent stack is fully green. Endpoint shapes: (a) GET /api/rewards returns {rewards:[...]} with 'id' key (mongo _id folded). (b) POST /api/rewards/recognition auto-approves points-only rewards (status='approved') and credits balance immediately via credit_points → users.haul_points + points_ledger. (c) Ghost accounts (TestCrewAdmin etc.) log in as owner; must call POST /api/auth/switch-role {role:'crew'|'sales'} to test tier-gated behavior. (d) Catalog endpoint is /api/rewards/catalog (owner GET returns items; POST requires owner). (e) /api/rewards/redeem requires a real user principal (403 for owner or role-only tokens) — to exercise the redemption flow end-to-end via pytest you must log in as a real user account (e.g. one of the QA crew fixture accounts from conftest). (f) Void on a reward whose user has been hard-deleted returns 404 'No such member.' from credit_points — safe to ignore in normal ops but any cleanup script should use direct mongo delete for orphan rewards. (g) Legacy invariants: crew rates 28/24, badges 27+, 4 existing challenges with legacy badge/title/combo reward kinds, /api/leaderboard + /api/hall-of-fame both 200. (h) Frontend testids all landed correctly; owner /team-admin route shows both new Rewards + AI Agent tabs; drafts are auto-seeded (6 drafts waiting including Lead Comeback Challenge, Weekly Deposit Sprint, Perfect Prep Team Challenge, Safety Scout, etc.).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only cleanup nuance: void endpoint refuses to void a reward whose user has been hard-deleted (as happens with the QA Crew ephemeral fixture accounts that are dropped at pytest teardown). Not a product bug; cleanup script uses direct mongo delete for orphan test rewards.
